title: Bhargava Gamma functions for determinant-admissible sets
summary: Bhargava's factorial construction attaches to a subset $S$ of a Dedekind domain a sequence of factorial ideals determined by local $p$-orderings. We introduce determinant-admissibility, a framework for factorial calculi whose local ordering data admit canonical carry, orbit, or renewal models together with compatible relative determinants. For such sets, the natural analogue of the Gamma function is generally not a scalar-valued function but a completed determinant line.
